name: 1701 Prairie Avenue — Italianate mansion with rear addition (district draft; refined by T-1875, T-1876)

function.note: The 1911 sheet labels the building with a 1911 use, '2½-storey brick dwelling over a stone basement (D, '2½SB'), with a 1-storey stone (blue) piece at its north-west corner and frame porches', which the draft does not carry back to 1904 (the T-1837 register warns not to assume the 1904 use from it). The register's family row, 'Italianate mansion with rear addition', names it a house, so the 1904 function is inferred residence on that row and the T-1840 census ruling (present_as_mapped).

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2335, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1875, T-1876 refine in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 20 trace (s20fp-1701-b1), the T-1840 census (s20-1701-f, s20-1701-a1) and the T-1837 register row frontage-20-032 (Italianate mansion with rear addition); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-prairie-16-18-east-2335).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-1840 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.
